# Reconcile invoices vs bank statement; memos cite invoices as INV-1007 / inv1007 / "invoice 1023".
import csv, json, re
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
# "inv"/"invoice" + optional separator + 4 digits; will not match "unidentified 1099".
REF = re.compile(r"\binv(?:oice)?[\s\-]*(\d{4})\b", re.IGNORECASE)

invoices = {}
with open(root / "backoffice" / "invoices.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        invoices[row["id"]] = Decimal(row["amount"])

payments = defaultdict(list)
skipped = []
with open(root / "backoffice" / "bank_statement_june.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        m = REF.search(row["memo"])
        if not m:
            skipped.append(row["memo"])
            continue
        inv = f"INV-{m.group(1)}"
        if inv not in invoices:
            skipped.append(row["memo"] + " (unknown invoice)")
            continue
        payments[inv].append(Decimal(row["amount"]))

unpaid = sorted(i for i in invoices if i not in payments)
duplicated = sorted(i for i, p in payments.items() if len(p) > 1)
# mismatched: exactly one payment whose amount differs; duplicated excluded by exclusivity
mismatched = [
    {"id": i, "invoiced": float(invoices[i]), "paid": float(payments[i][0])}
    for i in sorted(payments)
    if len(payments[i]) == 1 and payments[i][0] != invoices[i]
]

out = {"unpaid": unpaid, "duplicated": duplicated, "mismatched": mismatched}
with open(root / "reconciliation.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

print("skipped lines:", skipped)
print("matched payments:", sum(len(p) for p in payments.values()), "of", len(invoices), "invoices")
print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
